cases.source:
proc p {} {set x 1; if {[info exists x]} {unset x; puts $x}}
p

proc p {} {set x 1; if {[info exists x]} {puts $x}}
p

proc p {} {set x 1; if {[info exists x]} {unset x; set x 2; puts $x}}
p

proc p {} {set x 1; set y 1; if {[info exists x]} {unset y; puts $x}}
p

proc p {} {set x 1; if {![info exists x]} {} else {unset x; puts $x}}
p

proc p {} {set x 1; upvar 0 x linked; if {[info exists x]} {unset linked; puts $x}}
p

proc p {} {set a(k) 1; if {[info exists a(k)]} {unset a(k); puts $a(k)}}
p

proc p {} {set a(k) 1; set a(j) 2; if {[info exists a(k)]} {unset a(j); puts $a(k)}}
p
